limitations: Historical model comparison, not current dictation delivery acceptance.
Guard and fallback can preserve output despite a model rejection.
Gemma variability is retained in the source report and is not reduced to one ranking.

method: A historical cleanup comparison uses a matching 42-assertion evaluation. The failed-assertion count and median cleanup time describe different dimensions.
Retained Gemma configurations vary; no single median or quality score is assigned to that result. These configurations do not establish current whole-app delivery performance.
findings: 11/42 failed assertions; 8.58 s median cleanup. Historical tested configuration.

Apple passed all 42 assertions in the retained suite. MiniCPM was faster but failed 3, Qwen3 failed 8 and Qwen3.5 failed 11. Speed and quality must be read together; these are historical observations.
report.purpose: How much waiting does text cleanup add, and does the configuration preserve the meaning and formatting the fixture requires?
